// # Parse results
//
// What reading a number from text returns (CONVENTIONS.md, partial operations, style 2): a
// value and a validity flag, so a parser reports a malformed number as data and goes on.

// The result of reading a real number from text (`ParseNumber` in `text.library.plato`).
// When Ok is true Value is the correctly rounded number the text spells; when Ok is
// false the text was not a number in the P21 real forms and Value is 0 and means nothing.
type NumberParse
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Number;
    Ok: Boolean;
}

// The result of reading an integer from text (`ParseInteger` in `text.library.plato`).
// When Ok is true Value is the Integer the text spells; when Ok is false the text was not
// an optional sign and digits, or its value does not fit Integer, and Value is 0 and means nothing.
type IntegerParse
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Integer;
    Ok: Boolean;
}
